{C:81900300}{C:819582969E3200000000}Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:819582969F3200000000}Don't ask me.
Or do you want to hear
the same answer for the fourth time?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A23200000000}No, that's all right.

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB3200000000}At last... the final continent.
Will this be the end of everything...?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EC3200000000}Are you scared?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296ED3200000000}I'm not afraid of fighting.

{C:81958296EE3200000000}(What scares me
 is not getting Lun back.)

{C:8190B801}{C:819582965E0100000000}If you can think that way, you'll be fine.
Right, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296EF3200000000}Yeah.
Besides, we're with you too.
Don't worry.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296F03200000000}But don't get overconfident.
Carelessness can bring unexpected danger.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296F13200000000}If we all stick together,
there's nothing to fear.
We're heroes, after all!

{C:81909302}{C:81958296F23200000000}That's right! With us,
the Ganba Team, here,
there's no way we'll lose!!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296F33200000000}Now, now, everyone.
Do not let your guard down.
There's no telling what may happen.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296F43200000000}Like getting shot down out of nowhere.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296F53200000000}Oh, will you shut up?!
We'll find out when we get there!
Isn't that enough?!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F63200000000}Now, now,
please calm down, Leccee.

{C:81958296F73200000000}I know things will still
be difficult for everyone,
but please keep helping us.

{x00}
